about: LOD 400 Ugandan steel casement window (LTZ 40x40x2 angle) with a transom and a louvred vent or top-hung glass fanlight over, mid-height glazing bar, mosquito mesh and 12 mm burglar bars, on a precast sill projecting 30 mm. Height runs from the template Sill plane (z = 0) to Head; leaf top = Height - Fanlight Height. Leaf Count (1-4) places up to three fixed mullions; unused mullions, louvres vs fanlight glass, mesh and burglar bars (Show Burglar Bars) are switched by Yes/No- and count-driven offset formulas that collapse the part into the left jamb (Hide Offset / Hide Width) until the engine has a visibility op. Burglar bars: up to 8 verticals at <= 150 centres (Bar Count = roundup(clear / 150) - 1, max 8, so widths over ~1.3 m clear space them wider) plus flat rails at the glazing bar and transom; when off they also move inside the frame depth (Bar Y Offset). Exterior is -y; frame centred on the wall. Elevation opening triangles are symbolic lines drawn for the default 2-leaf type and do not flex.

ops.name: 1200x1600_2Leaf-Louvre400/FMC_Frame_Spec
ops.value: LTZ steel casement, frame 40x40x2 angle (IOM BoQ W1), 30 mm T mullions and glazing bar, 4 mm clear glass in putty; louvred or top-hung glass vent over; 12 mm sq burglar bars; precast sill

ops.name: Mullion 1 Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Count > 1, Frame Width + (Width - 2 * Frame Width - (Leaf Count - 1) * Mullion Width) / Leaf Count, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Mullion 2 Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Count > 2, Frame Width + 2 * (Width - 2 * Frame Width - (Leaf Count - 1) * Mullion Width) / Leaf Count + Mullion Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Mullion 3 Offset
ops.formula: if(Leaf Count > 3, Frame Width + 3 * (Width - 2 * Frame Width - (Leaf Count - 1) * Mullion Width) / Leaf Count + 2 * Mullion Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Louvre L Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Frame Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Louvre R Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: Glass L Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Hide Offset, Frame Width)

ops.name: Glass R Offset
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, Hide Offset + Hide Width, Width - Frame Width)

ops.name: Mesh L Offset
ops.formula: if(FMC_Mosquito_Mesh, Frame Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Mesh R Offset
ops.formula: if(FMC_Mosquito_Mesh, Width - Frame Width, Hide Offset + Hide Width)

ops.name: FMC_Vent_Type
ops.formula: if(Vent Louvred, "Louvre", "Top-hung glass fanlight")

ops.name: Bar Y Offset
ops.formula: if(Show Burglar Bars, Frame Width, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar Count
ops.formula: if(roundup((Width - 2 * Frame Width) / Bar Target Pitch) - 1 > 8, 8, roundup((Width - 2 * Frame Width) / Bar Target Pitch) - 1)

ops.name: Bar Pitch
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width) / (Bar Count + 1)

ops.name: Bar 1 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 0), Frame Width + 1 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 2 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 1), Frame Width + 2 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 3 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 2), Frame Width + 3 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 4 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 3), Frame Width + 4 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 5 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 4), Frame Width + 5 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 6 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 5), Frame Width + 6 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 7 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 6), Frame Width + 7 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: Bar 8 Offset
ops.formula: if(and(Show Burglar Bars, Bar Count > 7), Frame Width + 8 * Bar Pitch - Bar Size / 2, Hide Offset)

ops.name: FMC_Glazed_Area_m2
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Height - Fanlight Height - Frame Width) + if(Vent Louvred, 0, (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Fanlight Height - 2 * Frame Width))

ops.name: FMC_Openable_Area_m2
ops.formula: (Width - 2 * Frame Width - (Leaf Count - 1) * Mullion Width) * (Height - Fanlight Height - Frame Width) + if(Vent Louvred, 0, (Width - 2 * Frame Width) * (Fanlight Height - 2 * Frame Width))

Glass 4 mm clear in putty.source: register: glass 4/5 mm in putty; IOM BoQ

Burglar bars 12 mm sq at <= 150 centres,.source: owner brief; pattern to confirm with fabricator
